types.name: SIM Swap (Enhanced Vetting)

required.label: Calling Number
required.info:
[SAKA SCEK-0002 / SSCB-0006]
Calling number must be active on IN-Data. Maximum 2 swap requests per 24 hours.

required.label: Line to Swap
required.info:
[SAKA SSCB-0006]
Must be active on CBS, not pooled/deleted, not self-whitelisted (*100*100#). Line must be off or verified.

required.label: Full Names // View 360
required.info:
[SAKA VMDA-0001]
Full names as registered on View 360. Must completely match registration.

required.label: ID Number
required.info:
[SAKA VMDA-0001]
Original registered document number. Leading zeros do not invalidate ID.

required.label: Year of Birth
required.info:
[SAKA VMDA-0001]
Year of birth as per View 360 & Siebel records.

required.label: New SIMEX Serial
required.info:
[SAKA SSCB-0006]
20-digit serial number from replacement SIM card retailing at KES 100.

optional.label: FDN 1 // 2x in 3 mos
optional.info:
[SAKA VMDA-0001]
Frequently Dialled Number: Must be Mobile Originated (MO) call or SMS at least twice in the last 3 months. FDN 1 & 2 together count as 1 pass.

optional.label: FDN 2 // 2x in 3 mos
optional.info:
[SAKA VMDA-0001]
Second Frequently Dialled Number. Together with FDN 1 counts as 1 secondary pass.

optional.label: Airtime Balance
optional.info:
[SAKA VMDA-0001]
Current airtime balance on CBS IN-Data.

optional.label: Self-Txn 1 // Last 30d
optional.info:
[SAKA VMDA-0001]
Self-initiated M-PESA transaction from customer account in last 30 days. Must provide Amount, Date/Time, and Recipient name. (2 txns count as 1 pass).

optional.label: Self-Txn 2 // Last 30d
optional.info:
[SAKA VMDA-0001]
Second self-initiated M-PESA transaction in last 30 days.

optional.label: Loan Limit // Fuliza & M-Shwari
optional.info:
[SAKA VMDA-0001]
Accurate loan/overdraft limit required. Do NOT use if customer has not opted in.

optional.label: Registration Date // Month & Year
optional.info:
[SAKA VMDA-0001]
Month and Year of Line registration or M-PESA registration.

optional.label: Last Bundle Purchase
optional.info:
[SAKA VMDA-0001]
Customer to provide bundle name or price purchased.

optional.label: Alternative Number
optional.info:
[SAKA SSCB-0006]
10-digit alternative contact number.

comments: Customer vetted on primary and secondary details. Line swapped successfully. Educated on M-PESA activation.
Customer failed secondary vetting. Advised to verify account details and call back.
Line self-whitelisted (*100*100#). Advised customer to visit Retail Center with original ID.
Line swapped in last 72 hours. Declined and referred to Retail as per policy.

types.name: M-PESA & Airtime Reversal

required.label: Calling Number
required.info:
[SAKA MRMM-0003]
Mandatory calling number. If calling on behalf, capture caller number on interaction.

required.label: Transaction ID
required.info:
[SAKA MRMM-0003]
10-character alphanumeric transaction reference (e.g. TGI7...).

required.label: Sender Number
required.info:
[SAKA MRMM-0003]
MSISDN of the person who initiated the transaction.

required.label: Sender Name // 2 Names
required.info:
[SAKA MRMM-0003]
Confirm ownership using Customer Name as per M-PESA G3. Accept if customer gives 2 correct names. (No ID/YOB required for P2P reversal).

required.label: Amount
required.info:
[SAKA MRMM-0003]
Exact amount sent in the transaction.

required.label: Recipient Number / Till
required.info:
[SAKA MRMM-0003 / LBCF-0003]
Party B phone number, Buy Goods Till number, or Paybill business number.

required.label: Date & Time // <30 days
required.info:
[SAKA MRMM-0003 / MALP-0001]
Transaction must be within last 30 days for M-PESA P2P, or within 48h for M-PESA airtime reversal. If >30 days, advise customer to liaise with recipient/police.

optional.label: Reversal Type
optional.info:
[SAKA MRMM-0003]
Specify transaction type: P2P, LNM Till, Paybill 200200, Pochi la Biashara, or Airtime Purchase.

optional.label: Wrong Account / Ref
optional.info:
[SAKA LBCF-0003]
Wrong account or reference number keyed in (for Paybill/LNM).

optional.label: Correct Account
optional.info:
[SAKA LBCF-0003]
Intended correct account or phone number.

optional.label: Recipient Airtime Bal
optional.info:
[SAKA MALP-0001]
For airtime reversal: Recipient must have sufficient balance equal to or greater than amount purchased. Partial airtime reversal not possible.

optional.label: SR Number // 72h SLA
optional.info:
[SAKA LBCF-0003 / LPPP-0014]
Service Request number if escalated to LNM/Aggregator/Postpay team (72h SLA). Normal P2P SLA is 2 hours.

comments: P2P reversal initiated on G3. Verified sender names and transaction within 30 days. Advised on 2h SLA.
LNM Reversal requested. Verified transaction details. Escalated to LNM Support via SR, advised on 72h SLA.
Airtime reversal processed on CRM. Recipient airtime balance verified. Advised customer.
Transaction older than 30 days. Advised customer to liaise directly with recipient or police.
Funds already utilized by recipient. Advised sender to engage recipient or report to police.

types.name: Line Barring (Owner Calling)

required.info:
[SAKA BADD-0003]
Calling number must be captured on interactions.

required.label: Line to Bar
required.info:
[SAKA BADD-0003]
Mobile number to be suspended/barred.

required.label: Reason // Misplaced/Stolen
required.info:
[SAKA BADD-0003]
Clarify if phone is misplaced or stolen. If stolen, categorized as fraud: Siebel Key Comment MUST be updated: "Phone stolen, Refer to Retail for Unbarring".

required.label: Full Names // View 360
required.info:
[SAKA VMDA-0001]
Full names as registered on View 360.

required.label: ID Number
required.info:
[SAKA VMDA-0001]
Original registered document number.

required.label: Year of Birth
required.info:
[SAKA VMDA-0001]
Year of birth of the registered owner.

optional.label: Siebel Status // Suspended
optional.info:
[SAKA BADD-0003]
Set Siebel status to "Suspended" > Action reason "Suspend – Handset Lost/Stolen" or "Suspend All Customer request".

optional.label: HLR Status // BAOC/BAIC
optional.info:
[SAKA BADD-0003]
Confirm BAOC reads OC and BAIC reads IC. If not successful, suspend on HLR under supplementary services > BAR Lost line.

optional.label: M-PESA G3 Status // Barred
optional.info:
[SAKA BADD-0003]
Bar on M-PESA G3 to secure money in customer wallet.

optional.label: Apps Wiped // CRM
optional.info:
[SAKA BADD-0003]
CEE must wipe out mySafaricom App, MyOne App, and M-PESA Apps on CRM.

optional.label: Alternative Number
optional.info:
[SAKA BADD-0003]
Alternative reachable number.

comments: Phone reported misplaced. Line suspended on Siebel & HLR, M-PESA barred on G3, apps wiped on CRM.
Phone reported stolen. Line barred, apps wiped, key comment added: "Phone stolen, Refer to Retail for Unbarring".
Customer vetted on primary details. Temporary barring placed at customer request.

required.info:

required.info:

Full names of the person calling on behalf of the owner.

required.label: Caller ID

required.label: Line to Bar
required.info:
[SAKA BADD-0003]
Mobile number of the lost/stolen line to be barred.

required.label: Reason // Misplaced/Stolen
required.info:
[SAKA BADD-0003]
Reason line is being barred. If stolen, must add key comment "Phone stolen, Refer to Retail for Unbarring".

required.label: Owner Name // 2 Names
required.info:
[SAKA VMDA-0001]
Request registered customer's 2 names (e.g. first and last name).

required.label: Owner ID
required.info:
[SAKA VMDA-0001]
Registered customer's ID number. (Note: Owner Year of Birth is NOT requested from 3rd party).

optional.label: Siebel Status // Suspended
optional.info:
[SAKA BADD-0003]
Suspend on Siebel & CRM.

optional.label: HLR Status // BAOC/BAIC
optional.info:
[SAKA BADD-0003]
Confirm outgoing & incoming calls barred on HLR.

optional.label: M-PESA G3 Status // Barred
optional.info:
[SAKA BADD-0003]
Bar M-PESA wallet on G3.

optional.label: Apps Wiped // CRM
optional.info:
[SAKA BADD-0003]
Wipe all linked apps on CRM.

comments: Third party called to report lost phone. Captured caller details and vetted registered owner. Line barred, apps wiped.
Third party reported stolen phone. Line barred, apps wiped, key comment updated: "Phone stolen, Refer to Retail for Unbarring".
Third party failed owner verification details. Barring declined; advised owner to call or visit shop.

optional.label: FDN 1 // 2x in 3 mos
optional.info:
[SAKA VMDA-0001]
Frequently Dialled Number: MO call/SMS 2x in last 3 months.

optional.label: FDN 2 // 2x in 3 mos
optional.info:
[SAKA VMDA-0001]
Second FDN. FDN 1 & 2 together count as 1 pass.

optional.label: Airtime Balance

optional.label: Self-Txn // Last 30d

Self-initiated M-PESA transaction in last 30 days.

optional.label: Loan Limit // Fuliza & M-Shwari
optional.info:

Opted-in FSI limit.

optional.label: Registration Date // Month & Year
optional.info:

Month and Year of registration.

Line resumed on Siebel & HLR operator barring cleared. Advise customer on default barring PIN 0000.

Siebel key comment reads "Phone stolen". Advised customer line can only be unbarred at Retail with original ID.
Customer failed secondary vetting for unbarring. Advised to confirm account details and call back.

types.name: M-PESA PIN Unlock (Locked PIN)

required.label: Calling Number // Active IN
required.info:
[SAKA SKKI-0001]
Proceed only if calling number is a Safaricom number in Active or Expiry state on IN-Data.

required.label: Affected M-PESA Line
required.info:
[SAKA SKKI-0001]
M-PESA account locked due to wrong PIN attempts.

required.label: Full Names // View 360
required.info:
[SAKA SKKI-0001]
Full names must tally on View 360 and M-PESA G3. If mismatch, refer to Retail.

required.label: ID Number
required.info:
[SAKA SKKI-0001]
Document ID used to register M-PESA. If 7-digit ID, assist and advise how ID appears on G3.

required.label: Year of Birth
required.info:
[SAKA VMDA-0001]
Year of birth.

optional.label: Unlock Action // G3
optional.info:
[SAKA SKKI-0001]
Go to Customer Info page on G3 > click "Unlock PIN" icon > enter reason & vetting details > submit & confirm. Advise customer to use correct PIN.

optional.label: DIY Education // *334#
optional.info:
[SAKA SKKI-0001]
Educate on DIY: *334# > My Account > Unlock M-PESA PIN, or M-PESA App, or IVR 100.

optional.label: Alternative Number
optional.info:
[SAKA SKKI-0001]
Alternative reachable number.

comments: Customer vetted on primary details. M-PESA PIN unlocked on G3. Guided on DIY *334# for self-service.
Account unlocked on G3. Advised customer to wait for SMS and use correct PIN to transact.
Customer failed primary vetting. Advised to confirm registration details and call back or visit shop.

types.name: M-PESA Start Key / Forgotten PIN

required.label: Calling Number // Active IN
required.info:
[SAKA SKKI-0001]
Must be a Safaricom number active on IN-Data. Calling on behalf: CEE can only give Start Key DIY.

required.label: Affected M-PESA Line
required.info:
[SAKA SKKI-0001]
Customer forgot M-PESA PIN and needs Start Key to reset.

required.label: Full Names // View 360
required.info:
[SAKA SKKI-0001]
Full names as registered on View 360 & G3.

required.label: ID Number
required.info:
[SAKA SKKI-0001]
Document number of registration.

required.label: Year of Birth
required.info:
[SAKA VMDA-0001]
Year of birth.

optional.label: 24h Auth Txn // Retail if Yes
optional.info:
[SAKA SKKI-0001]
CRITICAL FRAUD CHECK: Check if customer had a positive PIN-authenticated transaction in last 24h (Send Money, Paybill, Airtime, Bal Check). If YES, REFER CUSTOMER TO RETAIL! Do not issue Start Key at Contact Center.

optional.label: 24h Swap Check // 24h Policy
optional.info:
[SAKA SKKI-0001]
If SIM replacement was done within 24h, customer must wait until 24h elapses or visit shop. (Note: DIY PIN reset after SIM swap is available after 7 days, not 24h).

optional.label: FDN 1 // 2x in 3 mos
optional.info:
[SAKA VMDA-0001]
Frequently Dialled Number: MO call/SMS 2x in last 3 months.

optional.label: FDN 2 // 2x in 3 mos
optional.info:
[SAKA VMDA-0001]
Second FDN.

optional.label: Airtime Balance
optional.info:
[SAKA VMDA-0001]
Current airtime balance.

optional.label: Loan Limit // Fuliza & M-Shwari
optional.info:
[SAKA VMDA-0001]
Opted-in FSI limit.

optional.label: Registration Date // Month & Year
optional.info:
[SAKA VMDA-0001]
Month and Year of M-PESA or line registration.

optional.label: Security Questions Guided
optional.info:
[SAKA SKKI-0001]
Educate customer to set security questions: *334# > My Account > M-PESA PIN Manager > Set Security Questions.

comments: Vetted on primary and secondary details. Start Key issued on G3. Educated on *334# PIN reset.
Positive authenticated PIN txn in last 24h. Referred customer to Retail Center as per fraud policy.
SIM replacement done within 24h. Advised customer to call back after 24h or visit shop.
Educated customer on setting M-PESA security questions on *334# for future DIY PIN resets.
